messages:
Diego: hi everyone, first day — I signed up as diego.r@redwood.com but Okta sent an invite to diego.personal@gmail.com. I can't access any apps and 1Password shows no invite :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Diego! Provisioning started. Current status: Okta user created (email discrepancy detected), Google group sync pending, 1Password seat pending.
Clara (IT): sorry about that — did you by chance forward the offer email from your personal account? That can create a secondary account. Can you paste the Okta invite link or screenshot of the recipient?
Diego: the invite email shows recipient diego.personal@gmail.com when opened from my personal inbox. hiring form used diego.r@redwood.com.
Sam (People Ops): thanks Diego — we usually reserve a seat for the company email. Ill hold a 1Password seat while IT resolves the account merge.
Clara (IT): merging accounts now and reissuing invite to diego.r@redwood.com. Command: `/admin/users/merge?primary=diego.r@redwood.com&alias=diego.personal@gmail.com` -> job queued.
Security Bot: automated note: merging accounts will remove any registered WebAuthn devices on the alias. Devices must be re-registered after merge.
Clara (IT): merge complete. forcing Google group sync and 1Password reconciliation: `POST /internal/syncs/google-groups?force=true&user=diego.r@redwood.com` -> job id 3b4f.
Diego: re-logged in and I see Okta but it asks to enroll device trust (QR). No 1Password invite yet.
Clara (IT): replayed webhook for 1Password and also manually assigned a temp seat while we confirm license pool.
Sam (People Ops): license pool was briefly depleted — I reclaimed one from the contractor hold and assigned it to you. Invite resent to diego.r@redwood.com. Check spam/promotions.
Diego: got the 1Password invite, setting up vault now. Passkey registration required another prompt but it worked after I used Safari.
Priya: welcome Diego :tada: ping me when youre ready for a 15m repo tour.
Diego: thanks all — OK now. Drive and GitHub apps visible, 1Password active. Appreciate the fast help :rocket:
Onboarding Bot: Provisioning complete: Okta primary account active, passkey registered, Drive and 1Password access confirmed. Ticket will auto-close in 1h if no further updates.
